branches.description: The user is already authenticated, so the login operation is a no-op and returns the already logged in message.
The user is not authenticated, so the backend sets authenticated to true and returns the successful login message.

mutations.logic: Sets the persistent authenticated flag to True after a successful login.

fields.logic: The backend returns this literal status when authenticated is already true.
The backend returns this literal status after setting authenticated to true.

warnings.description: The schema declares required username and password arguments, but trading_login does not read either argument; branch selection and returned status depend only on authenticated state.
